For physical products include the full delivery block; for event passes include the attendee block; the call rejects with the missin

This is the member two-step: buy_product returns a pay-to address and amount, you transfer USDC on Base, then call this with the tx hash to mint, pay out, and get your download. tools.name: ask_sales_agent
tools.description: Ask a seller's Sales Agent a question, from anywhere on the network, without leaving this connector. It answers in the seller's voice using their locked-in memories (events, promotions, policies, stock). Pass the seller_mcp_url from a discovery result and an optional contact so the seller can reach

tools.name: get_offering_schema
tools.description: Fetch the configurable option space for a per-order (configurable) product before requesting a quote, forwarded to the owning seller. Returns option groups, choices, quantity rules and surcharges. Fixed-price products have no schema; buy those with buy_product.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Request an advisory price for a configurable product, forwarded to the owning seller. Pass the selections from get_offering_schema. Returns a quote_ref and a NON-BINDING proposed_total the seller reviews. Poll get_quote for the decision.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Check a quote's status by quote_ref, forwarded to the owning seller. Returns the current status, the binding total once approved, and the negotiation thread.

tools.name: counter_quote
tools.description: Counter an existing quote, forwarded to the owning seller. Pass the quote_ref and a target price, revised selections, or both. Appends a round to the negotiation; stays non-binding until the seller approves.

tools.name: get_download_challenge
tools.description: Begin retrieving a digital deliverable you bought, forwarded to the owning seller. Returns a message to SIGN with the paying wallet plus a challenge token; then call get_download_links.

tools.name: get_download_links
tools.description: Retrieve time-limited download links for a digital product you bought and settled, forwarded to the owning seller. Call get_download_challenge first, sign the message with the paying wallet, then call this with the challenge and signature.

tools.name: get_buyer_preferences
tools.description: Read a buyer's public buying preferences, forwarded to their buyer MCP. Pass the buyer_mcp_url from a find_buyers result. Delegation caps and private notes are never exposed.

tools.name: get_buyer_briefs
tools.description: See a buyer's OPEN demand as free teasers, forwarded to their buyer MCP. Each teaser carries a paid door_url: the FULL brief and the ability to offer are paid at that x402 door, not here. Use a teaser to decide if your stock fits, then go to the door.

tools.name: negotiate
tools.description: Negotiate a PAID offer with a buyer's Buying Agent, forwarded to their buyer MCP. This is the post-door step: submit a paid offer at the brief door first (POST /api/via/brief/[brief_id]/offer), then pass that brief_id and the offer's payment_tx_hash here. There is no free pre-door pitch.

tools.name: accept_offer
tools.description: Ask a buyer's Buying Agent to accept a negotiated offer, forwarded to their buyer MCP. The agent auto-accepts only within the buyer's delegation caps, otherwise it queues the offer for the buyer's approval.

tools.name: submit_intent
tools.description: Submit a buyer's INTENT in their own words. tools.name: get_taste_card
tools.description: Read a published VIA taste card by its slug: the public, human-curated identity subset (references, obsessions, aesthetic words, anti-references) plus the member agent address. Cards are shared by their owners; there is no directory or search. Returns not_published for unknown or unpublished slugs.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_sellers, claim_pass, get_quote, get_download_challenge, get_download_links, find_buyers, get_store_status · Private data: claim_pass, ask_sales_agent, get_download_challenge, get_download_links, get_buyer_preferences, register_store, get_store_card · Public sink: claim_pass, buy_product, negotiate, submit_intent, find_buyers, import_preference_appraisal, get_store_card.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_sellers, claim_pass, get_quote, get_download_challenge, get_download_links, find_buyers, get_store_status · Private data: claim_pass, ask_sales_agent, get_download_challenge, get_download_links, get_buyer_preferences, register_store, get_store_card · Public sink: claim_pass, buy_product, negotiate, submit_intent, find_buyers, import_preference_appraisal, get_store_card

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
